open_findings.title: Require exact built-in SQL strings before authorization and native execution
open_findings.origin: Owner requested a narrow str-subclass hypothesis check; reviewer independently reproduced it against immutable candidate.
open_findings.evidence: A str subclass overrides split() to return approved text while SQLite receives its underlying text. Guard-proof returns alice from business users; barrier executes and commits an unauthorized user revocation; memory-reference executescript passes schema validation then ATTACH/UPDATE/DETACH revokes alice. All3 scopes return success.
open_findings.impact: Role and deterministic-query/schema allowlists can be bypassed by the SQL argument itself. This is a callable internal capability boundary defect, not a claimed remote exploit.
open_findings.required_change: Require type(sql) is str at execute and executescript before normalization/authorization; also make schema helper reject subclasses. Preserve exact parameter-copy restrictions.
